newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatia sends top business mission to China - TV.
newsitem.headline: Croatia sends top business mission to China - TV.

text.p: Croatia's Economy Minister Davor Stern is leading a top business mission on a two-week tour of China and the Far East aimed at expanding their presence in new markets, state television reported on Sunday.

"With the help of state institutions a strong team of corporate people will attempt to pierce those large markets in order to realise their exports and development plans," Stern said in a statement before departure.
TV said Croatia and China would seek to boost their coperation during the exchange visit after some 160 Chinese businessmen already visited Croatia.
The former Yugoslav republic has a running shipbuilding cooperation programme with China and is said to be negotiating oil imports in exchange for vessels.
Its exports to the People's Republic totalled $24.2 million in the first nine months this year against $40.4 million worth of imported goods.
"This will be an opportunity for Croatia to take part in businesses competition in China," Chinese amassador to Zagreb Xie Xiqin told TV.
Representative of state-owned shipyards, Ante Baucic, said they were looking at reforging ties with partners in China and winning new deals.

Varteks textile firm and holder of license for Levi's jeans director said he was interested in a source of quality fabrics, while also seeking a foothold for exports to its vast market. -- Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075
